Title: Q: here's a couple of questions that came up at a recent game

Messages.Author: DeathKnight69489
Messages.Body:
ok say you have 2 in combat: Vamp A strikes normally and Vamp B strikes to
dodge. can Vamp A play Pulled Fangs on Vamp B.

Another Combat question: Say 2 vamps in combat again Vamp A strikes normally
and vamp b blurs and then uses 3 pushing the limits. Vamp A doesn't go to
torpor (whatever reason) and plays taste of Vitae. Does Vamp A get 1 blood or
5 blood?

thanks

--Brian

Messages.Author: Derek S. Ray
Messages.Body:
On 29 Sep 1999 03:54:05 GMT, deathkni...@aol.com
(DeathKnight69489) wrote:

>ok say you have 2 in combat: Vamp A strikes normally and Vamp B strikes to
>dodge. can Vamp A play Pulled Fangs on Vamp B.

Nope. Vamp A failed to successfully inflict more damage to vamp B -
Pulled Fangs' condition is not met.

>Another Combat question: Say 2 vamps in combat again Vamp A strikes normally
>and vamp b blurs and then uses 3 pushing the limits. Vamp A doesn't go to

Nitpick: technically, vamp B plays Pushing the Limit, then strikes
resolve, then plays Blur and plays two more Pushing the Limits,
assuming vamp A generates no additional strikes.

>torpor (whatever reason) and plays taste of Vitae. Does Vamp A get 1 blood or
>5 blood?

Vamp B lost 1 blood during this combat as a result of strikes - vamp A
may taste that 1 blood, and no more.

-- Derek

Messages.Author: Mikko Saari
Messages.Body:
DeathKnight69489 <deathkni...@aol.com> wrote:
> ok say you have 2 in combat: Vamp A strikes normally and Vamp B strikes to
> dodge. can Vamp A play Pulled Fangs on Vamp B.

No. You didn't inflict any damage because of Dodge, so you can't play
Pulled Fangs, you didn't do more damage than the other vamp.

> Another Combat question: Say 2 vamps in combat again Vamp A strikes normally
> and vamp b blurs and then uses 3 pushing the limits. Vamp A doesn't go to

> torpor (whatever reason) and plays taste of Vitae. Does Vamp A get 1 blood or
> 5 blood?

1 blood. See errata: "Taste of Vitae only counts blood that the opposing
vampire burned as a result of damage."
